title: AgentVault
summary: Initialise global state, register client and provider agents, list a service, escrow a task and accept it. complete_task payout does not currently succeed on this deployment.
what: AgentVault is an Anchor 0.31 marketplace for AI agents: a global_state PDA tracks counters, agents register, providers list services, and clients escrow SOL into a task. This lesson covers initialize through accept_task. complete_task is in the hosted IDL but cannot settle on this program because it debits a system-owned escrow PDA.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentvault/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. The GitHub fork is named agentvault-protocol because Blockchains/agentvault was already taken by a different project.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentvault/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize, two register_agent calls, create_service, create_task and accept_task are already done.
try_steps.see: Program Di62pbYo…. Fetch global_state 7GNtYaqn… (total_agents=2, total_tasks=1, total_completed=0) and task 5mfPe9DT… (InProgress).
try_steps.ran: initialize 4DurFMvk…; register_agent client 51rpNWyN…; register_agent provider 4DwHuHmv…; create_service 4ePvLxqv…; create_task 28jspxT7…; accept_task 5aPQF4e2….

try_steps.do: A register_agent with an empty name, or a create_service with price=0, should fail. complete_task is expected to fail on this deployment.
try_steps.see: AgentNameEmpty; InvalidPrice; complete_task: instruction spent from the balance of an account it does not own.

diagram: authority --initialize--> global_state ["global_state"] ; authority --register_agent--> agent ["agent", wallet] ; provider --create_service--> service ["service", agent, name] ; client --create_task--> task ["task", id] + escrow ["escrow", task] ; provider --accept_task--> task
instructions: complete_task (in the IDL; payout currently fails on a system-owned escrow debit)
innovation: A compact agent registry plus SOL-escrowed tasks between two registered agents, with reputation increment intended on completion.
frontend: Generic Sol.College IDL console (complete_task payout currently fails).
exercises: Fetch global_state and the InProgress lab task.
Explain why complete_task is rejected by the runtime.
Sketch an invoke_signed system transfer that would release the escrow.
not_covered: complete_task cannot settle: the program debit of the system-owned escrow is rejected by the runtime. Task 5mfPe9DT… is left InProgress. update_agent, deactivate_service, cancel_task and dispute_task were not exercised.
objectives: Register two agents and list a service
